title: 第十三章 黑市
slug: 民国我包国维黄埔一期
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

丝毫不怕，两个地痞无赖罢了。

和军校第一蒋羡耘拼刺刀，包国维没有必胜的把握，还要用点手段，但收拾这两小瘪三，正好试试手。

胆子的确够大的，自己革命军的军装都穿上了，他们两个还敢上。

“刚刚在饭馆吃饭，你小子大鱼大肉，我哥两吃了两素菜，油腥都见不着几个。小子，哥俩最近手头紧，你就当积德行善，不然你这胳膊腿可保不住了。”

广州城人口多，二人是惯犯，抢劫之后躲上一段时间想来就没事了。

混混随身还带了块铁片，挥舞而来。铁片带着风声，力道不算小，若是寻常人被砸中，真要废掉胳膊。

包国维现在的反应速度极快，身形微微一侧，轻松避开这一击，同时右手闪电般探出，精准扣住混混的手腕，指尖发力。

“唔！”疤脸混混吃痛，惨叫一声，铁片当啷一声掉在地上。包国维顺势一拧，混混的胳膊被拧到身后，身子不由自主地弯了下去，疼得浑身抽搐。

他二弟也冲了过来，包国维一拳打了过去，霸道得很。混混闷哼一声，像是被重锤砸中，身子弓成了虾米，捂着肚子蹲在地上，脸色惨白，连呼吸都变得急促起来。他怎么也没想到，这个看起来十六七岁的少年，力气竟然这么大。

军校的训练不是白给的，轻松解决了两混混。

两兄弟颇有默契开始求饶起来：“好汉饶命，长官饶命。

军爷饶命，饶命啊！

军爷，我上有八旬老母，下有黄口小儿，是我一时鬼迷心窍，您就放过我吧。”

包国维摁住他两让他们完全动弹不得：“看你二人也不过三十的样子，你老母怎么就八旬了。”

不敢动弹，就像被老虎钳子按住了一样，一挣扎，痛彻心扉：“爷，放过我们，放了我，让我做什么都行。”

只是抢劫的话，倒不至于要他两的命，杀人现在包国维也还没干过，参了军，迟早要上战场，迟早是要见血的，有这个心理准备：“手上有人命没有？平时不少干这种事吧。”

“没有没有，绝对没有。杀人的事，我们兄弟哪敢干，抢点小钱被抓了，就关上几天。人命官司，我兄弟二人是万万不敢沾上的。也不常干啊，已经好几个月没开张了，这不一出手就碰上了您。”

想去黑市看看，能不能把自己拼多多买的手表卖个好价钱，最好能换一辆自行车：“黑市在哪？”

“爷，您问我就问对人了，我还是个包打听啊，广州城就没有我不知道的。”手指一指：“就这个方向一直走，到了一家陈记茶馆后右转再直走上个二里地，就到了黑市上。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Not afraid at all, just two scoundrels.

Bao Guowei was not sure of winning in a bayonet duel with Jiang Xianyun, the number one in the military academy, so he had to use some tricks, but it was a good time to try his hand at dealing with these two weaklings.

They were indeed brave enough. Even though they were wearing the uniforms of their own revolutionary army, the two of them still dared to go up.

"I just had a meal at a restaurant. You, my brother, had a lot of fish and meat. My brother and I ate two vegetarian dishes, and there wasn't much oil in them. Boy, we are short of money recently, so you should be virtuous and do good, otherwise you won't be able to save your arms and legs."

Guangzhou has a large population and the two of them are habitual offenders. After the robbery, they would be fine if they hid for a while.

The gangster also brought a piece of iron with him and waved it.The iron piece carried the sound of wind and was quite powerful. If an ordinary person was hit by it, his arm would be destroyed.

Bao Guowei's reaction speed was extremely fast now. He turned his body slightly to one side and easily avoided the blow. At the same time, his right hand reached out like lightning and clasped the gangster's wrist accurately, using his fingertips to exert force.

"Ugh!" The scar-faced gangster screamed in pain, and the iron piece fell to the ground with a clang.Bao Guowei twisted it, and the gangster's arm was twisted behind his back. His body bent involuntarily, and his whole body twitched in pain.

His second brother also rushed over, and Bao Guowei punched him, very domineeringly.The gangster groaned, as if he had been hit by a heavy hammer, his body was bent like a shrimp, and he squatted on the ground holding his stomach, his face was pale, and his breathing became rapid.He never expected that this boy who looked to be sixteen or seventeen years old would be so strong.

The training in the military academy is not free, and the two gangsters were easily eliminated.

The two brothers had a tacit understanding and began to beg for mercy: "Hero, spare your life, sir, spare your life."

Master, spare your life, spare your life!

Master Jun, I have an eighty-year-old mother and a child with a yellow mouth. I was temporarily obsessed with this. Please let me go."

Bao Guowei held them down so that they could not move at all: "You two look like you are only thirty, how come your mother is already eighty?"

He didn't dare to move, as if he was being held down by a vise. When he struggled, it hurt his heart: "Master, let us go, let me go, I can do anything you want."

If it was just robbery, it wouldn't cost them both lives. Bao Guowei has never done murder yet. After joining the army, he will go to the battlefield sooner or later, and sooner or later he will see blood. He is mentally prepared: "Are there any lives on your hands? Many people do this kind of thing."

"No, no, absolutely not. We brothers don't dare to commit murder. If we are caught grabbing a small amount of money, we will be locked up for a few days. My brothers would never dare to get involved in a life-threatening lawsuit. We don't do it often. We haven't opened for several months. I bumped into you right away."

I want to go to the black market to see if I can sell the watch I bought on Pinduoduo at a good price, preferably in exchange for a bicycle: "Where is the black market?"

"Sir, you're asking the right person. I'm just asking around. There's nothing in Guangzhou that I don't know about." Pointing his finger, "Just keep walking in this direction. When you reach a Chenji Teahouse, turn right and walk straight for two miles, and you'll reach the black market."
